codeReview.summary: The feature adds deterministic fast-path plumbing and broad tests, but it does not implement the required partial fallback behavior. Current logic is all-or-nothing, which conflicts with expectedBehavior and VAL-EXTR-003.

issues.description: _try_deterministic_fast_path() returns None as soon as any single data request is unresolved/skipped (e.g., external source, missing table_id, unresolved cell). Then _run_extract_and_compute() falls back to extract_structured() for the whole spec, discarding any DRs that were already deterministically resolved (see solve.py lines 199, 220, 227, 236, 253, and fallback at 715-725). Required behavior says unresolved DRs should fall through to LLM extraction while resolved DRs remain deterministic.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The pipeline-worker skill mandates an explicit red-phase TDD check (tests should be run to confirm failure before implementation), but the worker transcript shows only passing test runs after edits while handoff skillFeedback still reports followedProcedure=true.
